purpose: Freeze existing app before new-cohort compatibility screening; no external predictions made.

evaluation_policy.inputs: Only documented equivalent measurements from FEATURES; retain fitted preprocessing. No fabricated clinical inputs or target-derived inputs.
evaluation_policy.eligibility: Independent provenance and overlap audit; documented label definition; feature coding/units/timing established; current app requires age and at least28/55 measured inputs per row. Report exclusions and missingness.
evaluation_policy.outcomes: Each of CAD/LAD/LCX/RCA evaluated only if independently observed with compatible semantics. CT and invasive angiography differences must remain explicit.
evaluation_policy.report: AUC, Brier, sensitivity, specificity, confusion counts and uncertainty where identifiable. A failed compatibility gate produces no external accuracy claim.
